task.notes: Tries K9: fold T3/Mab21l2->Gata4rep2 with the released wild-type series added for the reference's revert.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

raw.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition

raw_tail.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw_tail.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition
raw_tail.tail: eb_factor.finalize(y'), y gene_factor's log ratio as raw_c3 takes it and y' y with every negative entry on a down-infeasible gene set to 0: a gene whose reference level (harness.t3_mean_expression, the mean over the reference's cells of log1p CP10k) is below TAIL_PB_MIN cannot be a truth down-gene (the heart's B0_TREND_TAIL_RULE form, campaign/heart-b); no gene changed: raw's factor bit for bit

raw_tail_ctrl.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw_tail_ctrl.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition
raw_tail_ctrl.tail: eb_factor.finalize(y'), y gene_factor's log ratio as raw_c3 takes it and y' y with every negative entry on a down-infeasible gene set to 0: a gene whose reference level (harness.t3_mean_expression, the mean over the reference's cells of log1p CP10k) is below TAIL_PB_MIN cannot be a truth down-gene (the heart's B0_TREND_TAIL_RULE form, campaign/heart-b); no gene changed: raw's factor bit for bit
raw_tail_ctrl.tail_ctrl: as raw_tail on as many feasible genes (reference level at or above TAIL_PB_MIN) with a negative entry as raw_tail changes, drawn uniformly without replacement from those genes with default_rng([k9.PERM_SEED, TAIL_STREAM]); all of them, and the shortfall recorded, when fewer exist
